'''Ulaire Cantea Dark Destruction''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Ulaire Cantea]]
* '''Published:''' 6 December 2001 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Theed Palace]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time|ECC-D-thisdealisgettingworseallthetime.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PTheed Deal Cantea DS 2001 GPN.txt |Download]]

Man Vader, this deal is getting worse all the time.  Only if you are light side!

The published list has 61 cards.

== Strategy ==

Okay, you drop people down CAREFULLY, play DD, and drain for 14 a turn. If you play your cards right (bad pun) then you will be fine.  If you flip, okay.  If you dont, thats fine too.  Just watch out for EBO, they can drain for the same if allowed.

Emerson "Sparkz" Sklar
Ulaire Cantea
